title: Monte Carlo Simulation with Thermal Spike
action: Implement a kinetic Monte Carlo model on a 512×512 lattice. Randomly deposit particles and apply thermal spike flattening within a radius of 1, 2, or 3 nearest neighbours of the impact site. Run for 30 monolayers for each neighbour count. Save the final surface height arrays as NumPy binary files (e.g. surface_heights_n1.npy).

title: Extract Scaling Exponents
action: From the simulated surface height arrays, compute the root-mean-square roughness for each monolayer. Analyze roughness vs. thickness to extract growth exponent β and compute the height–height correlation function to extract roughness exponent α for each neighbour count. Output a CSV file with the exponents.
description: Scaling exponents alpha and beta for three thermal spike radii.
output_schema: CSV with columns neighbor_count (int), alpha (float), beta (float). One row per neighbor count 1, 2, 3.
